module.purpose: Provides the client-side React boundary that defers, prefetches, coordinates, and completes hydration according to configured hydration strategies.
module.summary: This module implements a hydration boundary for TanStack Start client rendering. It creates or reuses hydration gates, preserves server-rendered fallback HTML when necessary, emits hydration markers, coordinates prefetch work with hydration requests, listens for delegated hydration intent, and resolves React Suspense when hydration is permitted. It also reports hydration completion and cleans up listeners, controllers, and gates on unmount.
module.businessContext: Supports progressive hydration for server-rendered React applications, improving startup performance by delaying non-critical UI activation. Failures can leave boundaries unhydrated, surface prefetch errors, or remove expected fallback content.
classes: Gate (~L31): Hydration gate record extended with a promise for Suspense coordination
PrefetchController (~L32-40): Mutable controller tracking prefetch and hydration lifecycle state
functions: shouldDeferHydration (~L48-50): Determines whether a hydration strategy delays initial hydration
useLatest (~L52-56): Keeps a mutable reference synchronized with the latest value
useHydrationGate (~L58-322): Creates hydration state, prefetch coordination, markers, and cleanup
HydrationGate (~L324-339): Suspends rendering until the hydration gate resolves
HydratedBoundary (~L341-359): Fires completion callbacks once boundary hydration occurs
GenericHydrate (~L361-436): Renders hydration markers, fallback content, and hydrated children
requestHydration (~L264-288): Requests hydration after required prefetch work completes

io: Reads and mutates DOM marker elements and fallback HTML.
env: Checks server versus browser execution through isServer and window availability.

detail.name: shouldDeferHydration
preconditions: The strategy argument provides the _d and _t properties expected by the function.
postconditions: Returns the result of strategy._d() when strategy._d is truthy.
Otherwise returns whether strategy._t is not equal to "load".
When no defer predicate is used, the return value is boolean.
invariants: A truthy strategy._d takes precedence over strategy._t.
edgeCases: When strategy._d is truthy, strategy._d() is invoked and its result is returned.
When strategy._d is falsy and strategy._t is "load", returns false.
When strategy._d is falsy and strategy._t is any value other than "load", returns true.
detail.summary: Determines whether hydration should be deferred according to the supplied strategy. If the strategy provides a defer predicate, its result is used; otherwise any strategy type other than "load" defers hydration.

specLiterals.role: Strategy type value that disables deferred hydration when no defer predicate is provided.

specTests.then: The function invokes _d and returns that function's result without using _t.

detail.name: useLatest
preconditions: Must be called in a valid React hook execution context.
postconditions: Returns a ref object whose current property equals the supplied value.
The returned ref object is reused across renders of the same component instance.
invariants: The ref object's current property is synchronized with the most recent value after each call.
edgeCases: When the supplied value is undefined, null, or another falsy value, the ref current property is set to that value.
When the supplied value changes between renders, the same ref object is returned with its current property updated.
When the supplied value is an object, the ref current property tracks the supplied object reference without cloning it.

raises: React hook execution errors if called outside a valid React component or custom-hook context

stateMutations: Mutates the returned React ref object's current property on each invocation.
detail.summary: Maintains a React ref whose current value tracks the latest supplied value while preserving the ref object across renders.

specTests.when: The component renders and the hook returns.
specTests.then: The returned ref has current equal to the supplied initial value.

specTests.when: The hook is invoked on the second render.
specTests.then: The returned ref object is the same object as on the first render and its current property equals B.

detail.name: useHydrationGate
preconditions: The hook is called during a React component render.
The supplied props provide a hydration strategy through props.when and may provide an identifier prefix, prefetch callback or strategy, and preload callback.
postconditions: Returns a hydration gate, marker callback and marker element reference, the selected hydration strategy and marker hydration type.
Returns whether server HTML should be preserved and any captured prefetch error.
On client-side cleanup, aborts prefetch work, removes hydration listeners and releases the hydration gate.
invariants: The generated marker identifier is the React identifier, optionally prefixed by props.h.
The hydration gate's active marker type matches the selected hydration strategy.
The prefetch controller is initialized once per hook instance.
Prefetch work is started at most once per hook instance.
Hydration listeners are notified at most when hydration is first requested.
Aborted prefetch operations do not update prefetchError.
edgeCases: When props.when is a function, its hydration strategy is initialized once; server rendering selects the dynamic hydration strategy, while the client invokes the function.
When the strategy type is never and server HTML is not being preserved, the marker element's children are removed when the marker is attached.
When hydration is not deferred, or the selected strategy is never, the deferred hydration effect installs no hydration strategy listeners.
When no prefetch input is supplied, no prefetch operation is started.
When a prefetch callback rejects or a preload operation fails without abort, the failure is exposed as prefetchError rather than synchronously thrown.
When hydration is requested before prefetch completes, gate resolution waits for the prefetch promise; without such a promise, the gate resolves immediately.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Non-aborted prefetch failures are stored in the returned prefetchError state; they are not thrown by the hook.

stateMutations: Mutates React refs tracking the hydration strategy, gate, marker element, server HTML preservation, deferred hydration, prefetch status and controller.
Updates React prefetchError state when non-aborted prefetch work fails.
Mutates the hydration gate by updating its marker type and, while deferred hydration is active, temporarily replacing its resolve function.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns an object with gate, markerRef, markerElementRef, hydrateStrategy, markerHydrateType, prefetchError, and shouldPreserveServerHTML properties. A prefetch callback receives { element, signal, preload, waitFor }; a hydration strategy callback receives either { element, gate } or { element, prefetch } depending on lifecycle.
detail.summary: Creates and manages the hydration gate, marker reference, selected hydration strategy, and prefetch lifecycle for a hydration boundary. It defers or resolves hydration according to the strategy and reports non-aborted prefetch failures through the returned state.

specLiterals.role: Identifies a strategy that does not automatically hydrate and controls marker cleanup and deferred hydration behavior.
Identifies the strategy for which delegated hydration-intent listeners are not installed by this hook.

specTests.when: The returned gate's resolve path is requested.
specTests.then: Hydration is marked as requested, registered hydration listeners are notified and cleared, and the gate does not resolve until the prefetch promise fulfills.
The rejection is exposed through prefetchError and is not synchronously thrown from the hook.
The element's children are removed and fallback HTML is saved for the generated marker identifier.

detail.name: requestHydration
preconditions: prefetchControllerRef.current refers to a hydration controller
postconditions: The controller's hydrationRequested flag is true
Hydration listeners are notified and cleared when hydration is requested for the first time
If no prefetch promise exists, the hydration gate is resolved immediately
If a prefetch promise exists, at most one resolution or rejection handler is pending for it
invariants: Repeated calls do not notify hydration listeners more than once
Repeated calls do not attach multiple pending handlers while hydrationResolvePending is true
A rejected prefetch promise updates the prefetch error only when its abort signal is not aborted
edgeCases: When hydration has already been requested, listeners are not invoked again and are not re-cleared through the request branch
When no prefetch promise exists, resolveGate is called and the function returns without setting hydrationResolvePending
When a prefetch promise is already being handled, the function returns without attaching another handler
When the prefetch promise rejects after abortion, the error is ignored

Invokes and clears prefetchControllerRef.current.hydrationListeners on the first request
Sets prefetchControllerRef.current.hydrationResolvePending to true when handling a pending prefetch promise
May update the prefetch error state through setPrefetchError when the prefetch promise rejects without abortion
detail.summary: Requests hydration exactly once, notifies pending hydration listeners, and resolves or tracks the associated prefetch operation as appropriate.

specTests.then: The listeners are each invoked once, the listener collection is cleared, hydrationRequested becomes true, and resolveGate is called immediately

specTests.when: requestHydration is called and the promise rejects with an error

detail.name: HydrationGate
detail.signature: function HydrationGate(props: { gate: Gate; children: React.ReactNode })
preconditions: props contains a gate and React children.
The gate exposes a boolean resolved state.
postconditions: If isServer is truthy or window is undefined, the children are returned directly.
If the gate is resolved, the children are returned directly.
If the gate is unresolved in a client environment, hydration remains gated according to the client-side hydration mechanism.
invariants: The children are not transformed when returned directly.
An unresolved gate in a client environment is not treated as resolved.
edgeCases: Server rendering or an environment without window returns the children directly regardless of gate resolution.
A resolved gate returns the children directly in a client environment.
An unresolved gate in a client environment follows the remaining client-side gating path.
detail.summary: Controls whether the supplied React children are rendered immediately or remain gated by hydration state. On the server, when the environment is unavailable, or once the gate is resolved, it returns the children directly.

detail.name: HydratedBoundary

parameters.name: props

postconditions: The boundary renders or returns its supplied children.
Hydration notification is processed at most once for the mounted boundary instance.
invariants: The per-instance hydration flag is initially false.
Once the hydration flag is set, subsequent effect executions do not process hydration again.
edgeCases: When onHydrated is omitted, the boundary remains usable without invoking a general hydration callback.
When onStrategyHydrated is omitted, the boundary remains usable without invoking a strategy-specific callback.

detail.summary: Provides a React boundary around children that records whether hydration notification has already occurred. It supports optional callbacks for general hydration and strategy-specific hydration.

specTests.when: The hydration effect processes the boundary for the first time.
specTests.then: onHydrated is invoked once and onStrategyHydrated is invoked once with "boundary-1".
No hydration callback is invoked again.

detail.name: GenericHydrate
preconditions: The hydration strategy and gate data returned by useHydrationGate are valid for rendering.
postconditions: Returns a React element containing hydration marker attributes and either a non-hydrating fallback or a Suspense-wrapped hydration boundary.
When the strategy type is never and server HTML is not preserved, the returned marker contains the caller fallback and does not render the hydration boundary.
When a strategy hydration callback completes, the hydration marker attribute is removed and the strategy completion callback is invoked when provided.
invariants: The hydration marker includes the gate identifier.
The hydration marker includes the marker hydration type.
Strategy-provided marker attributes are applied unless the marker hydration type is dynamic.
The child content is rendered through HydratedBoundary for strategies that proceed through the hydration path.
edgeCases: If prefetchError is present, it is thrown instead of returning an element.
If the strategy type is never and server HTML is not preserved, only the marker wrapper and props.fallback are returned.
If server HTML should be preserved and getFallbackHtml returns HTML, the Suspense fallback renders it inside a display: contents wrapper using dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
If server HTML should be preserved but no fallback HTML is available, the preserved-server fallback is null.
If server HTML should not be preserved and props.fallback is absent, the Suspense fallback is null and the non-hydrating fallback content is also null.
If the marker hydration type is dynamic, strategy marker attributes are omitted.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Not specified beyond the HydrateProps and hydration-gate contracts.

stateMutations: Removes hydrateWhenAttribute from the marker DOM element when strategy hydration completes.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns a React.JSX.Element whose outer element is a div with the gate identifier under hydrateIdAttribute and the marker hydration type under hydrateWhenAttribute. Non-dynamic strategies may add strategy-provided marker attributes; the hydration path contains React.Suspense wrapping HydrationGate and HydratedBoundary.
detail.summary: Renders a hydration marker and conditionally coordinates deferred hydration around its child content. It propagates prefetch failures and selects either preserved server HTML, a caller fallback, or the hydrated boundary content according to the hydration strategy.

specLiterals.role: Preserves server fallback markup without introducing a visual wrapper.
Identifies the strategy mode that renders only the fallback when server HTML is not preserved.

specTests.then: The same prefetchError is thrown and no hydration element is returned.

specTests.when: GenericHydrate is rendered with a fallback.
specTests.then: It returns a marker div containing the gate identifier, marker hydration type, and fallback, without rendering Suspense, HydrationGate, or HydratedBoundary.

specTests.when: HydratedBoundary invokes onStrategyHydrated with an id.
specTests.then: hydrateWhenAttribute is removed from the marker element and hydrateStrategy._o is invoked with that id when defined.
